title: 第3章 业力缠身的回报第4章 职业与天赋
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒踏入石室的瞬间，身后的石门便无声地滑回原位，将外界的喧嚣与光线彻底隔绝。
一股奇特的静谧感瞬间包裹了他，空气中仿佛弥漫着某种难以言喻的能量微粒，让他的皮肤微微发麻。
这里并非他想象中的宏伟神殿或科技感十足的空间，反而出人意料地简朴。
这是一间不算宽敞的圆形石室，四周空无一物。
只有弧形的墙壁和穹顶上镶嵌着的几块矿石，正散发出柔和而稳定的白光。
石室的正中央，矗立着一根约一米多高的石柱。
石柱材质似玉非玉，似石非石，表面精心雕刻着无比繁复而玄奥的纹路。
此刻，正有银色的流光在这些纹路中缓缓游走，如同具有生命的灵液，让整根石柱显得神秘而神圣。
石柱的顶端上方，凭空悬浮着一颗约莫篮球大小的光球。
它像是由最纯净的水晶雕琢而成，通体散发着温润却不刺眼的光芒。
而在这水晶球的内部，赫然封装着一幅微缩的、正在自行运转的浩瀚星图！
无数细密的光点，代表着无数星球，正按照某种深邃莫测的规律缓缓旋转、公转，轨迹玄妙而精确。
在这片星图的中央，一颗硕大无比的、散发着苍茫厚重气息的星球占据着绝对的主导地位。
更令人震撼的是，足足十二颗炽烈的小型太阳，正围绕着这颗巨大星球，沿着各自复杂的轨道井然有序地运转，构成了一个完全违背苏醒过往宇宙认知的庞大天体系统。
一种无需言语解释的明悟，如同清泉般直接涌入苏醒的心湖
——那颗位于中央的伟岸星球，就是他所处的这个世界，始源大陆的本体！
直面这超越想象、诠释着此世根本法则的奇迹景象，苏醒心中只剩下对创造并维持这一切的的伟力，生出最纯粹的惊叹与敬畏。
苏醒站在那根刻满玄奥纹路的石柱前，深吸了一口气。
他不再犹豫，怀着一种近乎悲壮的决心，缓缓抬起了右手，然后将掌心稳稳地按在了那悬浮的、内蕴星图的水晶球上。
就在接触的刹那，一股清晰的吸力骤然传来！

水晶球表面仿佛瞬间变成了液态，将他的手掌严丝合缝地包裹、吸附住，不留下一丝空隙，他想抽回手已绝无可能。
紧接着，一股温暖、醇和的热流从相触点涌出，沿着他的手臂经脉，温柔却不可阻挡地流向四肢百骸。
这股暖流所到之处，每一个细胞都仿佛在欢欣雀跃，一种极致的舒适与安全感将他彻底淹没。
他感觉自己仿佛漂浮了起来，回归到了最原始、最安定的孕育之所
——那是他从未亲身有所记忆，但在此刻却无比确信的，如同母体羊水般的绝对温暖与宁静。
在这无与伦比的舒适感中，苏醒的意识渐渐模糊，沉溺其中，几乎要甜美地睡去……
然而，就在他心神最为放松的顶点，异变陡生！
一丝尖锐、冰冷、如同冰锥般的电流毫无征兆地狠狠刺入他的大脑深处！
“呃啊！”
苏醒猛地一颤，剧烈的刺痛感让他瞬间清醒。
而就在这剧痛之后，仿佛某种与生俱来的枷锁被猛然击碎，一道“闸门”
在他意识深处轰然洞开！
前世尘封的记忆，以无可阻挡之势汹涌喷薄而出！
从他作为婴儿第一次睁开眼看到的模糊光影，到那些早已在岁月中遗忘的童真细节。
从第一次尝到甜味的惊喜，到第一次踏入幼儿园的惶恐；
从结交第一个朋友的雀跃，到第一次操控游戏手柄的兴奋；
从偷偷观看光影碟片的好奇……
再到后来漫长的求学之路、青春期隐秘的暗恋、刻骨铭心的恋情与分离、步入社会的挣扎与迷茫……
父亲严厉背后的关切，母亲唠叨之中深藏的慈爱……
无数平凡而珍贵的瞬间，无数早已被遗忘的音容笑貌，此刻都以一种不可思议的清晰度，在他眼前、在他脑海里飞速闪回、重现。
content_en:
The moment he woke up and stepped into the stone chamber, the stone door behind him slid back into place silently, completely cutting off the noise and light from the outside world.
A strange sense of silence instantly enveloped him, and the air seemed to be filled with some indescribable energy particles, making his skin tingle slightly.
This was not the grand temple or technological space he had imagined. Instead, it was unexpectedly simple.
This is a round stone room that is not very spacious, with nothing around it.
Only a few pieces of ore inlaid on the curved walls and dome were emitting soft and stable white light.
In the center of the stone chamber, stands a stone pillar about one meter high.
The stone pillars are made of material that looks like jade but not jade, like stone but not stone, and the surface is carefully carved with extremely complex and mysterious patterns.
At this moment, there is a silver stream of light slowly moving through these lines, like a living spiritual liquid, making the entire stone pillar look mysterious and sacred.
Above the top of the stone pillar, there was a ball of light about the size of a basketball suspended out of thin air.
It seems to be carved from the purest crystal, and the whole body exudes a warm but not dazzling light.
And inside this crystal ball, there is a miniature star map that is rotating on its own!
Countless tiny points of light represent countless planets, which are slowly rotating and revolving according to some profound and unpredictable laws, with mysterious and precise trajectories.
In the center of this star map, an extremely huge planet exuding a vast and heavy atmosphere occupies an absolutely dominant position.
What is even more shocking is that twelve blazing small suns are orbiting this huge planet, orbiting in an orderly manner along their own complex orbits, forming a huge celestial system that completely goes against Awakening's past understanding of the universe.
A kind of enlightenment that requires no explanation in words, pouring directly into the awakening heart lake like a clear spring.
——The majestic planet in the center is the world he is in, the body of the Origin Continent!
Faced with this miraculous scene that transcends imagination and explains the fundamental laws of this world, Su Xing's heart is filled with the purest wonder and awe of the power that created and maintained all of this.
Su Xing stood in front of the stone pillar carved with mysterious patterns and took a deep breath.
He no longer hesitated, and with an almost tragic determination, he slowly raised his right hand, and then firmly pressed his palm on the suspended crystal ball containing the star map.
At the moment of contact, a clear suction force suddenly came!
The surface of the crystal ball seemed to turn into liquid instantly, wrapping and adsorbing his palm tightly, leaving no gaps. It was impossible for him to withdraw his hand.
Immediately afterwards, a warm, mellow heat flow emerged from the contact point, along the meridians of his arms, flowing gently but unstoppably to his limbs.
Wherever this warm current went, every cell seemed to be jumping for joy, and a sense of ultimate comfort and security completely overwhelmed him.
He felt as if he was floating and returned to the most primitive and stable birthplace.
——That was something he had never personally remembered, but he was extremely sure of it at this moment. It was as absolute warmth and tranquility as the amniotic fluid in the mother's body.
In this unparalleled sense of comfort, the awakening consciousness gradually blurred, indulged in it, and almost fell asleep sweetly...
However, at the peak of his most relaxed mind, a sudden change occurred!
A sharp, cold, ice-pick-like electric current pierced deep into his brain without any warning!
"Uh-huh!"
Su Xing trembled suddenly, and the sharp stinging sensation made him wake up instantly.
And just after this severe pain, it seemed as if some kind of innate shackles were suddenly broken, and a "gate"
A hole suddenly opened deep in his consciousness!
The dusty memories of the past life surged out with unstoppable force!
From the blurry light and shadow he saw when he opened his eyes for the first time as a baby, to those innocent details that have long been forgotten over the years.
From the surprise of the first taste of sweetness to the first time you step intoKindergarten panic;
From the joy of making your first friend, to the excitement of controlling a game controller for the first time;
From the curiosity of secretly watching light and video discs...
Then the long road to school, the secret crush in adolescence, the unforgettable love and separation, the struggle and confusion when entering society...
The concern behind the father's sternness, the deep love hidden in the mother's nagging...
Countless ordinary and precious moments, countless long-forgotten voices and smiles, were all flashing back and reappearing in front of his eyes and in his mind with an incredible clarity at this moment.
